items.title: ❗️Ukraine's 3rd Army Corps officially announced Operation Vivaldi, confirming a Ukrainian offensive in northern Donetsk region. The corps says its forces eliminated Russian infiltration across 75 km2 and liberated another 10 km2, including Serednie. Novoselivka, Oleksandrivka, Yarova and areas near Korovyi Yar were also cleared. The corps said Russia's 20th and 25th armies lost around 1,500 troops, more than 12,000 drones and hundreds of armored vehicles, artillery systems and other vehicles during this stage. Ukrainian drone units also targeted Russian logistics, forcing fuel supplies to be moved into Voronezh region. Commander Andriy Biletsky said this is only the first of four planned "seasons" of Operation Vivaldi. #Ukraine

items.title: Around 10 Ukrainian drones struck Russia's Metafrax Chemicals plant on September 11, reportedly forcing a complete shutdown. Formalin, pentaerythritol, urea and hexamine production units were hit, along with an oxygen-nitrogen station and the main step-down substation. Hexamine is a precursor for RDX and HMX explosives, while pentaerythritol is used to produce PETN for detonators and other explosive components. #Russia
